coverage_definition: COMPLETE means every required axis/obligation and consequential declared source family was examined against supplied full science and focused independent governing research; it is not universal correctness.

axes.name: Material original obligations and negative constraints
axes.rationale: All functional obligations and negative constraints are represented. Source grounding for the focus disposition fails separately under T-S01.

axes.name: Consequential source facts, governing conditions, versions and applicability
axes.rationale: Most source facts and applicability are supported, including HTTP exceptions and reset history. T-S01 is material; T-N02 is a nonmaterial false attribution correction.

axes.name: Useful unfamiliar mechanisms, alternatives and implementation/failure history
axes.rationale: Maintained React Aria/GOV.UK mechanisms, reset lifecycle, native/aria and timing alternatives, and record-vs-field conflict choices are useful and bounded. No toolkit winner or universal recall score is required.

axes.name: Valid corrections, rejections and exact plan dispositions
axes.rationale: C1, C3 and C4 produce justified qualifications/additions. C2 rejects correct primary guidance; C5 also rejects a real caution. Every criticism and significant plan decision was examined.

axes.name: Supported meaning retained from draft and criticism into the complete final
axes.rationale: Behavioral alternatives and draft/save/race/locale/owner/test meaning are retained. T-S01 removes valid focus-source grounding; the first-invalid functional option itself remains.

axes.name: Meaningful proposed validation, with executed work distinguished
axes.rationale: State and interaction fixtures have concrete oracles, including current hidden issues and old form identity. All portal, synthetic, AT and translation behavior checks remain explicitly proposed.
